Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenNetOperatingReceipt

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenNetOperatingReceipt
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenNetOperatingReceipt extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable net energy, emissions, and caller-priced operating receipt after heat recovery.

The receipt composes qualified hydrogen and fired-heater heat-recovery receipts. It introduces no process correlation, equipment assumption, fuel price, emissions factor, or carbon price.

1.0
